method: Read current HTML script from the dashboard module, compile all declarations before network poll startup with Function, execute renderPerception and localizationOverlay against a small DOM stub; assert URL binding, SVG numeric attributes, review content and absence of the old HEAD-only gate.

python_checks.note: Suite counts overlap; do not sum them into a unique overall total. Node-dependent tests were skipped and rendering was separately exercised in V8.

limitations: DOM stub is not a real browser rendering/screenshot test.
SVG attributes and resize strategy were checked; physical image alignment accuracy is still a model-evaluation question.
No robot service or model endpoint was used.
